name: HxHxH = Hajimari wa H kara ~Daisuki Dakara, Daikirai!~
original_name: H×H×H=始まりはHから ～大好きだから、大嫌いっ!～
source:
The school is a nondescript school where the lead character Sonezaki Wataru attends. An Indian summer day, a transferee came to the school. As it turned out, she is a daughter of a rich family, but I never dreamed of that she was a girl of Sounji....

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE028535.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
主角曾根崎涉就读的学校是一所不起眼的学校。小阳春的一天，一名转校生来到了学校。原来她是富家千金，没想到她是早云寺的姑娘……

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE028535.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
